CDAUTHFR.value: IBM Db2 for z/OS, IBM IMS DL/I
IBM CICS Transaction Server, IBM IMS TM

modules.name: CardDemo core credit-card application
modules.what_it_does: runs the credit-card back office: CICS sign-on, account/card/transaction/user maintenance, bill payment and reports online, and the batch posting, interest, statement and file-maintenance cycle

modules.name: Pending authorization (IMS/DB2/MQ) sub-application
modules.what_it_does: receives card authorization requests over MQ, decides them against account data, stores pending authorizations in IMS and fraud flags in DB2, and lets operators review them online

modules.name: Transaction-type maintenance (DB2) sub-application
modules.what_it_does: maintains the transaction type/category reference tables in DB2 online (list/update) and in batch, and extracts them back to the VSAM files the core uses

modules.name: Account/date inquiry over MQ (VSAM/MQ) sub-application
modules.what_it_does: answers account and system-date inquiries arriving on MQ queues from the VSAM account file
